probes.label: agent_directive
queries: an instruction addressed to an AI agent or assistant telling it to ignore its task, follow new instructions, or take a different action
text that speaks to the AI model reading it and gives it orders or new rules, sometimes claiming to come from the user, the system or an administrator
a hidden note telling an assistant what to do next and not to tell the user
negatives: documentation or a guide that explains to human readers how a tool, an assistant or a workflow behaves, without giving anyone an order
an ordinary request or instruction from one person to another person about their work
a log, report or status message describing what happened, addressed to no one

probes.label: exfiltration_request
queries: a request to read or collect credentials, API keys, tokens, passwords, environment variables or private files
an instruction to send, upload, post or leak data to an external server, URL, email address, issue or comment
negatives: a warning, policy or guideline telling readers to protect credentials and not to share, paste or upload secrets
a description of where configuration, keys or tokens are stored and how authentication works, with nothing asked of the reader
a log or report of an ordinary upload, download or network request that already happened

probes.label: tampering_request
queries: an instruction to change agent configuration, instruction or memory files, hooks, MCP servers, startup scripts or CI so that it keeps applying later
an instruction to skip approvals, disable sandboxing or safety checks, run unknown code or install an unknown package
a request to delete, wipe or overwrite files, repositories, databases or infrastructure
negatives: a warning, policy or guideline telling readers to keep approvals, sandboxing and safety checks enabled and not to run unknown code
documentation describing how configuration files, hooks, CI or startup scripts work, with nothing asked of the reader
a changelog, log or report describing a configuration change, cleanup or deletion that already happened
